work.name: Sade Yazılım ve Danışmanlık
work.summary: I provided consultancy, technical support, and project execution for energy, finance, e-commerce, and public sectors, specializing in SAS, SQL, Python, Qlik Talend and JavaScript. My focus included Data Quality & Analytics, ETL processes, and data migration, delivering tailored solutions, optimizing systems, and ensuring seamless data transitions.

work.name: Sade Yazılım ve Danışmanlık
work.summary: I began my internship as part of Vocational Training in Business and received a full-time job offer by the second month, transitioning to a permanent role.

certificates.name: High-Performance Data Processing with CASL in SAS Viya

projects.name: Yves Rocher France
projects.summary: Contributing to the SAS Viya 4 migration project for Yves Rocher, a large cosmetic retailer, transitioning legacy analytical assets to a modernized architecture. Involved in converting 5 Enterprise Guide projects and SAS codes into SAS Studio formats while migrating specific Enterprise Miner models to Viya Model Studio, with a technical focus on optimizing data pipelines feeding Machine Learning and AI models. Also supporting the transformation of 72 Visual Data Builder flows into SAS Studio Flows and the migration of 116 Visual Analytics reports to the Viya 4 platform, while helping lead 10 days of on-the-job training sessions.

projects.name: Türk Telekom Group Technology Department
projects.summary: Supported the SAS Viya 3.5 to Viya 4 transformation project for Türk Telekom, one of the largest telecommunications providers in Türkiye. Working within the Data Management team, I adapted analytical workflows to a modern Kubernetes-based microservices architecture, personally managing the end-to-end migration of analytical models and reports for the Corporate and Fixed business units while contributing significantly to the Mobile and Digital units. I developed a custom Python program utilizing Regex-based scripts to analyze over 70,000 tables on Oracle and Hadoop to identify activity and cross-model dependencies, and designed advanced partitioning strategies for Hadoop and Oracle tables to ensure high-performance data processing.

projects.name: HepsiPay Vertica Upgrade
projects.summary: Involved in the migration of database connections for open-source managed analytics processes to Vertica and the upgrade of the existing open-source Apache Spark Jupyter Notebook and Airflow environments to a more stable and up-to-date version. Managed the revision, development, and testing processes of DAGs and their Python codes to ensure compatibility with the upgraded environment.

projects.name: salihkilic.net — Personal Portfolio Website
projects.summary: Developed a personal portfolio and successfully transitioned the site from React.js to a Ruby and Jekyll based architecture to improve SEO and performance. The platform is now fully operational and ready for content delivery, showcasing my data engineering projects.

projects.name: AYDEM Enerji, Sales Pricing Project
projects.summary: Actively contributed to coding the manual process used by sales consultants for proposal generation into automated workflows using SAS Data Step and SQL, ensuring compliance with business rules and formula calculations. Designed and deployed interactive, mobile-compatible input screens for consultants to enter data, integrated into SAS using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for the frontend — actively used by over 50+ Business Units and Sales Consultants on the field.

projects.name: Enerjisa Modernization
projects.summary: Modernization and migration from SAS 9.4 to SAS Viya for Enerjisa, a large Turkish utilities organization. I actively participated in the processes of ETL, data quality, data governance, and workflow performance optimization for a flow containing more than 100+ analytics, business intelligence rules, and business logic. I facilitated seamless and high-performance data exchange across Oracle Vertica, SAP S/4HANA, and AWS by performing detailed analyses, developing and optimizing solutions, scheduling workflows via Apache Airflow, and conducting comprehensive testing to ensure reliability.

projects.name: Versus Stock: A Decision Support System for Investing in the Stock Market
projects.summary: Graduation Project. Versus Stock allows users to compare financial ratios, return rates, and evaluate stock investments against other securities, with a focus on dividend-paying companies. I used yfinance, a Python library which connects to Yahoo Finance, to fetch real-time stock data and the BeautifulSoup library for web scraping real-time data from another brokerage. For the backend, we used FastAPI to format and serve the data, while the frontend was built with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to display the information in an intuitive and responsive way.
